status: Fixed in source; frozen runner publication pending
finding: broker batch execute uses --run-command as a shell string for generated build/projection writes, which is fragile on Windows quoting and forces AI operators to debug shell syntax instead of declaring an executable command contract.
expectedBehavior: Generated-write execution should accept an argv-array or JSON command manifest surface, preserve exact arguments cross-platform, and expose first-layer skill/CLI guidance so operators do not rediscover shell quoting rules.
evidenceOrRepro: ATM-GOV-0187 implementation and test work required changing the test command to quote process.execPath for Windows; later runner build measurement also required switching between npm, npm.cmd, and shell:true surfaces before a valid run. Current reproduction: `tests/cli/real-build-projection-runner-sync-executor.test.ts` failed with `ATM_COMMAND_MANIFEST_REQUIRED` when the stale fixture used `--run-command`. Repair now loads the task's WAT into the restricted-execution gateway and updates the generated-write fixtures to shellless command manifests; `real-build-projection-runner-sync-executor.test.ts`, `generated-write-manifest.test.ts`, and `command-manifest-shellless.test.ts` pass, with typecheck and encoding guard also green.
followUp: Rebuild and publish the frozen runner through the governed runner-sync lane, then re-run the generated-write clean-install coverage before formal backlog closeout.
